title: Media
description: One logical media item — such as an image, a video, or a 3D model. `url` identifies the resource the Platform renders; `sources` lists alternate renditions; `preview` is a still.

type.description: Media type. Well-known values: `image`, `video`, `external_video`, `model_3d`. A Platform MUST NOT reject the containing object for an unrecognized value; it MAY present the item from `preview` and `name`, or omit it.

url.description: URL of the media resource the Platform renders; interpretation is specialized per `type`.

name.description: Human-readable title or label for the media, distinct from `alt_text` (accessibility text). Often present for `video` and `model_3d`.

width.description: Intrinsic pixel width of the media item, for image and video types; a rendition's own dimensions are on its `sources` entry.

height.description: Intrinsic pixel height of the media item, for image and video types; a rendition's own dimensions are on its `sources` entry.

duration.description: Duration in seconds, for time-based media such as `video` and `external_video`.

preview.description: Poster/thumbnail still the Platform renders before or instead of the primary resource. A Business SHOULD provide it for `video`, `external_video`, and `model_3d` unless no suitable still exists, and MAY provide it for `image` as a low-resolution placeholder.

width.description: Pixel width of the preview image.

height.description: Pixel height of the preview image.

sources.description: Alternate renditions of the resource at `url`. The Business SHOULD include the rendition at `url`.
